project.name: GhostKey
project.currentFocus: Bypass-first GhostKey learning web app: multi-method local analysis is the main concept, with Autokey kept as a sufficient coursework simulator.
durableFacts: MVP direction is a single Next.js App Router application with React, Tailwind CSS, Vercel deployment, and browser Web Workers for heavy cryptanalysis.
MVP has no custom backend, no database, and no auth unless saved labs, classroom management, accounts, sharing, or server-side processing are approved later.
Auto Detect is the default breach mode and runs in the browser worker without app/api routes.
Dual-use security boundary is documented: local educational analysis only, no remote attack automation, no bundled large cracking wordlists.
Design anchor is now an interactive classroom evidence bench, with Alice, Eve, Bob, readable formulas, and friendly learning colors retained for the Autokey simulator.
Autokey Cipher encryption and decryption with a user-provided key is the grading-safe simulator path, not the whole product identity.
Bypass Tool is now the primary product concept and targets classroom demos for Caesar, Reverse, Vigenere, Autokey, Monoalphabetic, Column, toy RSA, toy ElGamal, and JWT locally.
Autokey breach uses beam search over seed-key prefixes plus coordinate refinement, with Indonesian scoring support for classroom phrases.

Plaintext fitness now uses embedded English and Indonesian corpora to build local n-gram and frequency models, then meta-ranks solver outputs by language quality, solver confidence, complexity, and ciphertext length.
Confidence ceilings are centralized in src/lib/crypto-analysis/confidence-caps.ts and shared by Caesar, Auto Detect, classical solvers, and text-metrics ranking.
BreachResult now supports optional evidenceSignals for structured result panels while preserving evidence[] strings for the current UI.
Classical family scoring is centralized in src/lib/crypto-analysis/family-scorer.ts and shared by detection plus Auto Detect solver dispatch.
Language scoring now uses documented self-authored corpus assets with metadata in src/lib/crypto-analysis/language-corpora.ts and docs/corpus-assets.md.

Gemini AI Evidence Rerank now runs automatically after local plaintext candidates, uses POST /api/ai-rerank through Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform by default, returns accept/ambiguous/reject decision support, keeps service account credentials server-side, and falls back to local scoring when unavailable.

Autokey coursework UI includes Encrypt & Send, Decrypt Message, Reset, Eve confusion, Bob reveal, CSS characters, and formula rows for Pi, Ki, and Ci, and is considered enough for the current coursework requirement.
Auto Detect prefers strong cheap Caesar or Reverse evidence before expensive heuristic solvers and caps complex solver confidence on short artifacts.
Bypass Tool defaults to ciphertext-only attack mode. Optional crib attack mode can pass local known plaintext, probable words, and max key length hints for separate known-plaintext lessons.

lastAchievements: Reframed GhostKey docs and first-screen UI around a Bypass-first multi-method concept, with Autokey kept as a coursework simulator.
Added docs/cryptanalysis-upgrade-plan.md to capture the Claude-as-baseline, Gemini-as-supplemental research decision and Bypass implementation sequence.
Implemented the first two cryptanalysis upgrade steps: shared confidence caps and optional structured evidence signals.
Implemented the third cryptanalysis upgrade step: split family scoring from solver execution so Auto Detect can explain and order classical solver dispatch from one scorer.
Implemented the fourth cryptanalysis upgrade step: npm run test:bypass now runs dependency-free smoke fixtures across Auto Detect, classical methods, toy asymmetric audits, and JWT.

Implemented the fifth cryptanalysis upgrade step with documented self-authored English and Indonesian corpus assets, and closed the sixth step by deferring heavier search expansion until benchmark evidence shows a measured need.
Added optional Gemini AI Evidence Rerank: server route, UI toggle/review panel, env examples, gitignore safety, API docs, ADR update, and validation coverage.
Polished Gemini AI Evidence Rerank for production UX: removed the UI toggle/setup copy, made Gemini review automatic, and changed quota/key failures into calm local-scoring fallback.
Migrated Gemini AI Evidence Rerank from Google AI Studio API-key calls to Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform service-account calls with aiplatform.googleapis.com as the production default.
Changed Gemini Evidence Rerank from a side review panel into a final decision layer that accepts, caps as ambiguous, or rejects local plaintext candidates before the finding is promoted.
Improved Autokey breach so the sample ciphertext CICAFY QRRXGE SRKT XSJAK ranks KELAS -> SERANG MARKAS SAAT FAJAR first.
Replaced fixed phrase-heavy text metrics with corpus-built language scoring and Auto Detect meta-ranking across active solver results.
Added a live Autokey sender-observer-receiver simulation with formula tables to strengthen the mandatory coursework path.
Split the primary UI into Autokey Cipher and Bypass Tool tabs, with staged compose, encrypt, intercept, and decrypt simulation states.
Restyled the primary Autokey surface from forced hacker/forensic styling into a friendlier classroom learning web app.
Simplified Autokey simulation controls to Encrypt & Send, Decrypt Message, and Reset, with Eve confusion and Bob reveal.
Lightened Bypass Tool panels and controls, removed leftover gray/dark result surfaces, and made tab switching reset stale Bypass findings.
Tuned Auto Detect so short ambiguous ciphertext is capped at low confidence while the user's Autokey sample still recovers KELAS -> SERANG MARKAS SAAT FAJAR.
Improved short Autokey seed ranking so MQO KOUN DNGOCOET recovers MS -> AYO MAIN VALORANT instead of a false high-ranking candidate.
Separated Bypass Tool into default ciphertext-only mode and optional crib attack mode so the main bypass path no longer implies prior plaintext knowledge.
pendingIssues: Current English and Indonesian scoring assets are self-authored and documented; externally sourced quadgram tables still need license review before replacement.
Classical breach results remain heuristic and work best on classroom-sized, sufficiently long ciphertext.
Phrase-specific classroom demos should still be smoke-tested before presentation.
nextBestActions: Expand npm run test:bypass with known-plaintext and crib-assisted demo cases.
Benchmark whether larger external quadgram assets are worth adding after license review.
If Gemini rerank gets public traffic, add optional request-rate controls.
